由本词复数形式固定为副词，义为「每天下午」

definition_zh: 之后；随后；后来；不久之后；以后
definition_en: at a later time, especially after an event that has just been mentioned
core_image: 事情过去以后，脚步声才在后面慢慢响起来
scene: 会议结束，人们收拾文件陆续离开，走廊里安静下来。We walked to the station afterwards.
sceneCN: 这里 afterwards 是「之后」（第 1 个义项：紧接刚提到的事情之后）；句意为散会之后我们步行去了车站。画面里可辨认的是会议桌、文件和空走廊。

pos.zh: 副词：之后；后来；以后

derivatives.zh: 美式拼写，去掉了副词属格词尾 -s，义同「之后；后来」
由 after 加 word 复合而成的名词，义为「后记；跋」，与 afterwards 拼写相近，但构词来源不同

senses.title: Just after an event
senses.definition: after an event that has just been mentioned, especially immediately after it
senses.definitionCN: 在刚刚提到的那件事之后，尤指紧接着其后
senses.example: We had lunch and afterwards walked along the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 我们吃了午饭，随后沿着海岸散步。
senses.why: Afterward began as æfterweard, 'towards the rear'; the later event stands behind the one just named, so afterwards marks what comes in the rear.
senses.whyCN: afterward 最初是 æfterweard「朝后方」，后发生的事站在刚提到的事背后，所以 afterwards 标记的是落在后面的那一件事。

senses.title: Later, after some time
senses.definition: at a later time, often after a noticeable interval, when looking back
senses.definitionCN: 在较晚的时候，常指隔了一段明显的间隔，多用于回顾
senses.example: She moved to another city and afterwards rarely called.
senses.exampleCN: 她搬到另一座城市，后来就很少打电话了。
senses.why: If the 'rear' lies far behind, the gap between the two events widens, and the word slides from 'next' to 'later on'.
senses.whyCN: 如果「后方」落在很远的地方，两件事之间的间隔就被拉开，词义也从「接着」滑向「后来」。

senses.title: Shortly after, with soon or shortly
senses.definition: used with soon, shortly or immediately to stress that very little time passed
senses.definitionCN: 与 soon、shortly 或 immediately 连用，强调经过的时间极短
senses.example: Shortly afterwards, the lights in the hall went out.
senses.exampleCN: 不久之后，大厅里的灯灭了。
senses.why: The interval is the only variable in the word, so an adverb that measures it can shrink the gap to almost nothing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词唯一的变量就是间隔长短，所以加上衡量间隔的副词，就能把间隔压到几乎为零。

senses.title: At a later point in the future
senses.definition: at a time after something that is still to happen, seen from the present
senses.definitionCN: 站在现在看，在某件尚未发生的事情之后的某个时间
senses.example: We can discuss the details afterwards, once the guests have gone.
senses.exampleCN: 等客人走了以后，我们可以再谈细节。
senses.why: The same 'behind' image works for a future event: the talk lies behind the dinner that has not yet taken place.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「在后面」的图像也适用于将来的事：谈话落在还没发生的晚餐之后，于是 afterwards 指「以后」。

intro.en: Afterwards is afterward plus an old adverbial ending, and its history begins with a purely spatial word.
intro.cn: afterwards 是 afterward 加上一个古老的副词词尾，它的历史从一个纯空间词开始。

items.en: Æfter meant 'after, behind', and it forms the first element of the compound.
items.cn: æfter 意为「在……之后、在后面」，构成这个复合词的前半部分。

items.en: The suffix -weard meant 'turned towards', as in modern towards and homeward.
items.cn: 后缀 -weard 意为「朝向」，现代英语的 towards 与 homeward 仍保留这个成分。

items.en: Æfterweard meant 'behind, in the rear', a spatial adverb with no time sense yet.
items.cn: æfterweard 意为「在后面、朝后方」，当时还是一个纯空间副词，尚无时间义。

items.en: The meaning moved from place to time, and afterward came to mean 'later, after that'.
items.cn: 词义从空间移到时间，afterward 开始表示「后来、在那之后」。

items.en: An adverbial genitive -s was added, giving afterwards; the exact first date of this form is uncertain.
items.cn: 副词属格词尾 -s 被加上，形成 afterwards；这个形式的确切首见年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the American spelling, a look-alike compound and two adverbs built with -wards; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of later time.
note.cn: 形近组收美式拼写、一个形近复合词与两个以 -wards 结尾的副词；近义组收表示较晚时间的副词。

entries.definition: The American spelling of the same adverb, without the final s.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「之后、后来」，是本词的美式拼写，去掉了末尾的 s。

entries.definition: A short section at the end of a book; formed from after and word, not from this adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「后记、跋」，由 after 与 word 复合而成；只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: A preposition meaning in the direction of; it shares the adverbial -s ending but not the root.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「朝、向」，同样带副词属格词尾 -s，但词根不同。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning forward in time or space; built with the same -wards ending.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「向前、以后」，构词时用的是同一个 -wards 词尾，但词根不同。

entries.definition: At a time after the present or after the moment being discussed.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「后来、稍后」，只强调时间较晚，不强调紧接着。

entries.definition: Afterwards, in a formal or report style.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「随后、之后」，语气正式，多用于报告与叙述。

entries.definition: After that time, often suggesting a continuing state; more formal and more bookish.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「此后」，常暗示某种状态持续下去，语气比 afterwards 更书面。

entries.definition: Immediately after this one, in a sequence; it looks forward rather than back.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「紧接着、下一个」，强调次序上的紧邻，方向朝前而不是回顾。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real route from æfterweard to afterwards and the phrases that measure the gap.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子沿着从 æfterweard 到 afterwards 的真实路径，并配合衡量间隔的常见说法。

normal.en: Afterwards is afterward plus the adverbial -s, the same ending as in towards and onwards.
normal.cn: afterwards 是 afterward 加副词词尾 -s，与 towards、onwards 的结尾相同。

normal.en: The oldest form, æfterweard, meant 'towards the rear', a purely spatial picture.
normal.cn: 最古老的形式 æfterweard 意为「朝后方」，是纯空间的图像。

normal.en: American English usually drops the s and writes afterward.
normal.cn: 美式英语通常去掉 s，写作 afterward。

normal.en: Shortly afterwards and soon afterwards measure the gap between the two events.
normal.cn: shortly afterwards 与 soon afterwards 都在衡量两件事之间的间隔。

normal.en: The word never takes an object: it stands alone after the event has been named.
normal.cn: 这个词从不带宾语：事情点明之后，它自己单独站着。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs, and you sit in the second one only after the first is empty.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子，第一把空了，你才坐到第二把上。

abstract.en: The distance between the chairs can be a step or a year; the word does not care.
abstract.cn: 两把椅子之间的距离可以是一步，也可以是一年，这个词并不计较。

abstract.en: When the second chair is far away, afterwards quietly turns into 'later'.
abstract.cn: 当第二把椅子很远时，「之后」就悄悄变成了「后来」。

examples.en: We had lunch and afterwards walked along the shore.
examples.cn: 我们吃了午饭，随后沿着海岸散步。

examples.en: She moved to another city and afterwards rarely called.
examples.cn: 她搬到另一座城市，后来就很少打电话了。

examples.en: Shortly afterwards, the lights in the hall went out.
examples.cn: 不久之后，大厅里的灯灭了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿夫特沃兹」——脚步总落在事情后头：之后；隔得久了就成了后来。

root: 由 afterward 加副词属格 -s 构成。afterward 来自古英语 æfterweard「朝后方」，由 æfter「在后」加 -weard「朝向」构成；词义从中古英语起由空间转向时间，-s 是英语副词属格词尾，与 towards、onwards 同类。

sensesIntro.en: All four senses measure one distance: how far behind the mentioned event the next thing stands, from the very next moment to a point in the future.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项都在量同一段距离：下一件事落在刚提到的事情后面多远，可以近在下一刻，也可以远到将来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: once the event is over, footsteps sound behind it, at a distance that can be short or long.
core.cn: 核心意象：事情结束之后，脚步声才在后面响起，距离可近可远。

branches.en: THE NEXT THING: the following event stands directly behind the one just named.
branches.cn: 紧接着：后面那件事就贴在刚提到的事背后。

branches.en: THE WIDE GAP: when the rear is far off, the word reads as 'later'.
branches.cn: 长间隔：后方离得远时，词义就读作「后来」。

branches.en: THE NARROW GAP: soon and shortly shrink the distance to almost nothing.
branches.cn: 短间隔：soon 与 shortly 把这段距离压到几乎为零。

branches.en: THE FUTURE: the same rear position can be projected onto events not yet happened.
branches.cn: 将来线：同一个「后方」也能投射到尚未发生的事情上。

branches.en: ONE MEASURE: every sense asks the same question, how far behind the mentioned event the next one lies.
branches.cn: 同一把尺：所有义项问的都是同一个问题——下一件事落在刚提到的事后面多远。

intro.en: Afterwards is afterward plus an ending, and every element in it is native English.
intro.cn: afterwards 是 afterward 加一个词尾，其中每个成分都是英语本族成分。

latinIntro.en: The word is entirely Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so this column is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词完全来自日耳曼语，没有拉丁语同源词，所以这一栏留空。

items.example: It is the first half of the old compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个古老复合词的前半截。

items.example: It gives the compound its direction.
items.exampleCN: 它给这个复合词一个方向。

items.example: The old form was spatial before it was temporal.
items.exampleCN: 这个古老形式先有空间义，后有时间的义。

items.example: The word lost its final s in American spelling.
items.exampleCN: 这个词在美式拼写中少了末尾的 s。

items.example: It produced afterwards from afterward.
items.exampleCN: 它把 afterward 变成 afterwards。

items.example: It is the modern form of the old suffix.
items.exampleCN: 它是那个古老后缀的现代形式。

items.meaning: in the direction of, as an adverb
items.example: It appears in towards and onwards.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 towards 与 onwards 中。

items.example: It is the living first element of the word.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词仍然活跃的前半部分。

derivatives.zh: 美式拼写，去掉副词属格词尾 -s，义同「之后；后来」
由 after 加 word 复合而成，义为「后记；跋」，与 afterwards 拼写相近但构词来源不同

definition_zh: 再一次；又；回到原处；恢复原状；此外；而且；一再；再说一遍
definition_en: one more time, or back to a former place or state, or used to add a further point to what is being said
core_image: 关掉又拧开的开关：动作沿原路折回，落在同一个位置
scene: 面汤已经凉了，她把碗端回灶台重新加热。She read the letter again and folded it away.
sceneCN: 这里 again 是「再一次」（第 1 个义项：同一个动作又做一遍）；句意为她把这封信又读了一遍，然后折好收起。画面里是桌边的信纸、信封与一碗凉掉的汤。

pos.zh: 副词：再一次、又；回到原处；恢复原状；此外、而且

collocations.zh: 又来了；老一套又开始了

forms.label: 副词（无屈折变化，也没有比较级）

derivatives.zh: 由本词的属格副词形式加 -t 演变而来，义为「反对；靠着」
由本词重叠构成的固定短语，义为「一再；反复地」
由本词加 once 构成的固定短语，义为「再次；又一次」

senses.title: One more time
senses.definition: one more time, after something has already happened at least once
senses.definitionCN: 在某事已经发生过至少一次之后，再做一次或再发生一次
senses.example: Could you spell your surname again?
senses.exampleCN: 你能再把姓拼一遍吗？
senses.why: Old English ongean pointed a movement back towards its starting point; repeating an act is that same turning back, moved from space into time.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ongean 指动作朝起点折回；把同一件事再做一遍，就是这种折返从空间挪到时间里的结果。

senses.title: Back to a former place
senses.definition: back to a place that someone or something has left
senses.definitionCN: 回到某人或某物曾经离开的地点
senses.example: After two years abroad, he came home again.
senses.exampleCN: 在国外待了两年后，他又回到了家。
senses.why: The oldest recorded use is physical: a path that turns back on itself and ends where it began, which is why the word still carries the picture of a return.
senses.whyCN: 有记录的最早用法是空间上的：一条路折回自身、终点回到起点，所以这个词至今保留「回去」的画面。

senses.title: Back to a former state
senses.definition: back to a condition or situation that something was in before
senses.definitionCN: 回到某物此前所处的状况或情形
senses.example: The swelling went down and her ankle was normal again.
senses.exampleCN: 肿消了，她的脚踝又恢复了正常。
senses.why: If the word can carry a person back to a place, it can carry a body or a system back to a condition; health, calm and order are treated as places one can return to.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词能把人带回某个地点，也就能把身体或系统带回某种状况；健康、平静与秩序都被当成可以折返的「位置」。

senses.title: In addition; moreover
senses.definition: used at the start of a statement to add a further point, often a reservation
senses.definitionCN: 用于一句话的开头，补充另一点，常带保留或提醒的意味
senses.example: Again, the plan is expensive, and we have no time.
senses.exampleCN: 再说，这个方案很贵，而我们没有时间。
senses.why: Talk is pictured as a path: to add a point the speaker turns back to the same topic and sets one more item beside it, exactly as the word turns back in space.
senses.whyCN: 说话被想成一条路：要补充一点，说话人就把话头折回原来的题目，在旁边再放一条，和这个词在空间上的折返完全一致。

senses.title: Over and over
senses.definition: many times in succession, especially in the repeated phrases again and again and time and again
senses.definitionCN: 接连许多次，尤用于重叠短语 again and again 与 time and again
senses.example: The same question came up again and again in the interviews.
senses.exampleCN: 同一个问题在访谈中一再出现。
senses.why: Repeat the return itself and the path becomes a loop that never settles: every turn back is one further occurrence, which is what the doubled phrase names.
senses.whyCN: 把「折返」本身重复，路径就成一个停不下来的圈：每折回一次就是又发生一次，这正是重叠短语所指的意思。

senses.title: Say that again
senses.definition: used in a question or command to ask someone to repeat words that were just spoken
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句或命令句，请对方把刚说过的话重复一遍
senses.example: What was the name again?
senses.exampleCN: 名字叫什么来着？
senses.why: Asking for a repetition turns the time sense into a request: the words must travel the same path back to the listener's ears one more time.
senses.whyCN: 请求重复把时间义变成了一种请求：那些话必须沿同一条路再回到听者耳朵里一次。

intro.en: Again goes back to a Germanic word for facing or moving against something, and its shorter spatial sense of return later grew into the modern sense of repetition.
intro.cn: again 可追溯到日耳曼语中表示「相对、迎面」的词，它较窄的「返回」空间义后来长成现代的「重复」义。

items.en: A reconstructed form *gagana is generally taken to mean 'against, opposite'. The deeper Indo-European source is uncertain and is not reconstructed with confidence.
items.cn: 一般认为原始日耳曼语的重构形式 *gagana 表示「相对、迎着」；更早的印欧语来源不确定，无法有把握地重构。

items.en: Ongean meant 'towards, against, opposite' and also 'in return, back'; it was written both as one word and as the phrase on gegn.
items.cn: ongean 表示「朝向、相对、迎面」，也表示「回报、返回」；它既写作一个词，也写作短语 on gegn。

items.en: In Middle English the word was worn down to ayen and ayein, and the sense 'back, in return' became the everyday one.
items.cn: 到中古英语，这个词磨损成 ayen 与 ayein，「返回、回报」成为日常义。

items.en: An adverbial genitive ending -es produced againes, and a later excrescent -t produced against; the new form specialised in the sense of opposition and contact.
items.cn: 副词属格词尾 -es 造出 againes，后来加上赘音 -t 又造出 against；这个新形式专管「相对、抵住」的意思。

items.en: The two forms parted company: again kept the senses of repetition and return, while against kept opposition, contact and defence.
items.cn: 两个形式从此分工：again 保留重复与返回，against 保留反对、抵住与防备。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms from the same old word or from the same Germanic root, plus one word that only looks similar; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs and particles of repetition and return.
note.cn: 形近组收同一古词或同一日耳曼词根的形式，另收一个只是长得像的词；近义组收表示重复与返回的副词和虚词。

entries.definition: A preposition of opposition, contact or defence, historically an inflected form of again.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「反对、靠着、防备」，历史上是 again 的屈折形式发展出来的独立词。

entries.definition: A formal verb meaning to deny or contradict; its first element comes from the same Germanic root for 'against' as again.
entries.definitionCN: 正式动词，义为「否认、反驳」；它的前半部分与 again 同出日耳曼语表示「相对」的词根，但不是由 again 直接派生。

entries.definition: To obtain something, especially by effort; it merely looks like the second half of again and comes from a French verb.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「获得、收益」；只是拼写与 again 的后半截相近，词源不同，来自古法语动词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning profitable or paid; built on gain, which is unrelated to again.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有收益的、有报酬的」；由 gain 加后缀构成，与 again 只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: One further time; close to again but slightly more formal and often used in speeches and toasts.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「再一次」，与 again 最近，但语气稍正式，常用于演讲与祝酒。

entries.definition: Many times, again and again; it states the repetition plainly and takes no return image.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「一再、多次」，直接把重复说出来，不带「折返」的画面。

entries.definition: To or towards a former place or state; the spatial half of again, without the sense of repetition.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「回、向后」，只承担 again 的空间一半，不含「再做一次」的意思。

entries.definition: Again, but from the beginning and in a new way; it stresses a fresh start rather than a mere repeat.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「重新、从头再来」，强调以新的方式重新开始，而不只是重复一遍。

entries.definition: In addition and in a more formal register; it covers the additive sense of again without the spoken tone.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「此外、而且」，语气比 again 正式，只对应它的补充义。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded Old English form, the shared root with against, and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子使用有记录的古英语词形、与 against 共享的词根，以及这个词真实出现的搭配。

normal.en: Old English ongean is the same word that later split into again and against.
normal.cn: 古英语 ongean 就是后来分成 again 与 against 的同一个词。

normal.en: Double the word and the loop is clear: again and again means one turn after another.
normal.cn: 把词叠起来，循环就看得见：again and again 就是一圈接一圈。

normal.en: Once again is the single-repeat version, common in speeches and announcements.
normal.cn: once again 是「再来一次」的单次版本，常见于演讲与通告。

normal.en: Then again turns the talk back to the other side of a question.
normal.cn: then again 把话头折回问题的另一面，所以是「话说回来」。

normal.en: Here we go again is said when a familiar annoyance starts over.
normal.cn: here we go again 用于熟悉的麻烦又重新开始时，意为「又来了」。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow that flies out and then bends back to the exact point it left, leaving a small loop in the air.
abstract.cn: 想象一支箭飞出去又弯回出发的那一点，在空中留下一个小圈。

abstract.en: A tape rewound to the same mark: the same passage will play once more.
abstract.cn: 磁带倒回同一个标记：同一段内容会再放一遍。

abstract.en: A pendulum swinging back over the same arc shows how return and repetition are the same movement at different speeds.
abstract.cn: 钟摆沿同一段弧线摆回来，说明「返回」与「重复」只是同一动作的不同速度。

examples.en: She read the note again before folding it into her pocket.
examples.cn: 她把那张纸条又读了一遍，才折好放进口袋。

examples.en: The children were told again and again not to cross the road alone.
examples.cn: 孩子们被一再告知不要独自过马路。

examples.en: Again, we have to ask who will pay for the repairs.
examples.cn: 再说，我们不得不问这些维修费由谁出。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿盖恩」——阿盖把同一句话又念了一遍：再一次；又。

root: 古英语 ongean「朝向、相对、返回」一般认为来自原始日耳曼语重构形式 *gagana「相对、迎着」，更早的印欧语来源不确定。中古英语作 ayen、ayein，其属格副词形式再经 -t 演变为 against，与 again 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses of again all work the same figure: something travels out and comes back to where it started, whether the return is a place, a condition, a repeated act, a further point or a request to repeat words.
sensesIntro.cn: again 的六个义项共用同一个比喻：某物出去又回到起点，区别只在于回到的是地点、状态、重复的动作、补充的一点，还是被请求重复的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow curves out and comes back to the mark it started from.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭飞出后弯回它出发的那个标记。

branches.en: REPETITION: one turn back gives one more time; many turns give the doubled phrase again and again.
branches.cn: 重复线：折回一次就是又一次，折回多次就是重叠短语「一再」。

branches.en: PLACE: the movement ends at the spot it left, the oldest and most physical sense.
branches.cn: 地点线：动作在离开的地点结束，这是最古老也最具体的义项。

branches.en: STATE: the same return applied to health, calm or order instead of to a place.
branches.cn: 状态线：同样的返回用在健康、平静或秩序上，而不是用在地点上。

branches.en: DISCOURSE: the speaker turns the talk back to the topic and lays one more point beside it.
branches.cn: 话语线：说话人把话头折回原题，在旁边再补一点。

branches.en: REQUEST: the words must travel the same path back to the listener one more time.
branches.cn: 请求线：那些话要沿同一条路再回到听者那里一次。

intro.en: Again is historically two elements joined in Old English, and the pair split into two words in Middle English.
intro.cn: again 在古英语里由两个成分合成，到中古英语这对成分分成了两个词。

latinIntro.en: No recorded Latin cognate is securely attached to this Germanic word, so the Latin list is left empty; only the general Latin prefix re- is given for comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 没有可靠记录的拉丁同族词可以系在这个日耳曼词上，因此拉丁同源词一项留空；只列出拉丁前缀 re- 作为对照。

items.example: It is the first element of the old form ongean.
items.exampleCN: 它是古词形 ongean 的第一个成分。

items.example: It supplies the facing sense of the whole word.
items.exampleCN: 它提供整个词「迎面相对」的意思。

items.example: It appears inside again and inside gainsay.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 again 与 gainsay 里面。

items.example: It produced the older form againes.
items.exampleCN: 它造出了较早的形式 againes。

items.example: It was added to againes and gave against.
items.exampleCN: 它被加在 againes 后面，产生了 against。

items.example: It appears in afresh, a near cousin in meaning.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 afresh 中，那是意思相近的词。

items.example: English marks repetition with it in retell and rebuild.
items.exampleCN: 英语用它在 retell、rebuild 中标记重复。

items.example: It turns repeated into repeatedly.
items.exampleCN: 它把 repeated 变成 repeatedly。

definition_zh: 反对；不赞成；靠着；抵着；与……对抗；与……对比；以防；违反；以……抵付
definition_en: in opposition to someone or something, in contact with and pressing on something, in contrast to it, or as protection from it
core_image: 两个人面对面站定，肩膀抵住，谁也不肯后退
scene: 天还没亮，旅人把背贴在冰冷的石墙上歇脚。He leaned against the damp wall and listened.
sceneCN: 这里 against 是「靠着、抵着」（第 2 个义项：身体贴住某物并把重量压在它上面）；句意为他靠着潮湿的墙，听着外面的动静。画面里是清晨的石墙与旅人的背影。

pos.zh: 介词：反对；靠着；对抗；对比；以防；违反

derivatives.zh: 由本词加前缀 there- 构成的法律用语，义为「对此；反对此」
由本词构成的固定短语，义为「与时间赛跑」
同源词，against 由它的属格副词形式演变而来，义为「再一次；返回」

senses.title: In opposition to
senses.definition: in opposition to a person, plan, idea or proposal
senses.definitionCN: 对某人、某个方案、想法或提议持反对立场
senses.example: Most of the staff voted against the merger.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数员工投票反对这次合并。
senses.why: The oldest form of the word means facing something, so to be against a plan is to stand face to face with it as an opponent.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的形式表示「面对某物」，所以反对一个方案，就是像对手那样与它面对面站着。

senses.title: Resting on and pressing
senses.definition: touching something and resting or pressing one's weight on it
senses.definitionCN: 贴着某物，并把身体或物体的重量压在它上面
senses.example: She propped the ladder against the apple tree.
senses.exampleCN: 她把梯子靠在苹果树上。
senses.why: This is the same facing posture with the hostility taken out: a body is set face to face with a surface and lets the surface carry it.
senses.whyCN: 这是同一个面对面姿态去掉了敌意：身体与某个表面相对，让表面承受自己的重量。

senses.title: In a contest with
senses.definition: in a competition, fight or argument with an opposing person or side
senses.definitionCN: 在与对方或对方一队的比赛、争斗或争论之中
senses.example: The young team will play against the champions on Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 这支年轻球队周六将与冠军队交手。
senses.why: Two sides face to face is the plainest picture of a contest; the word names the side opposite you, not who wins.
senses.whyCN: 两边面对面，是比赛最直白的画面；这个词标出的是对面的那一方，而不是谁赢。

senses.title: In contrast with
senses.definition: used to show the background or standard by which something is seen or judged
senses.definitionCN: 用来提出观察或评判某物的背景与标准
senses.example: The dark towers stood out against the evening sky.
senses.exampleCN: 黑色的塔楼在暮色中格外分明。
senses.why: Anything set against a surface is seen through its difference from that surface, so the facing relation turns into a relation of comparison.
senses.whyCN: 任何东西放在某个表面之前，都是靠与它的差别才被看见；面对面的关系因此变成比较关系。

senses.title: As protection from
senses.definition: as a defence or safeguard in case something harmful happens
senses.definitionCN: 为防某种有害的事发生而采取的保障措施
senses.example: The policy insures the house against flood damage.
senses.exampleCN: 这份保单为房屋投保水灾损失。
senses.why: To guard against something is to station yourself facing the direction it would come from, so the hostile sense is turned into prevention.
senses.whyCN: 防备某件事，就是站到它可能来的那个方向前面；敌对的义项由此转成「预防」。

senses.title: In breach of a rule
senses.definition: in a way that breaks or contradicts a rule, law or principle
senses.definitionCN: 以违反或抵触规则、法律或原则的方式
senses.example: Parking here is against the rules.
senses.exampleCN: 在这里停车是违反规定的。
senses.why: A rule is imagined as a line drawn in front of you; going against it is crossing that line from the wrong side.
senses.whyCN: 规则被想象成画在面前的一条线；against 它就是朝错误的一侧越过那条线。

senses.title: In exchange for payment
senses.definition: as payment for something, or as a charge on an amount or account
senses.definitionCN: 作为某物的付款条件，或记在某个金额、账户上的抵付
senses.example: The bank will release the goods against payment in full.
senses.exampleCN: 银行将在全额付款后放货。
senses.why: Two things are set face to face and exchanged, one released only when the other is presented; the same posture becomes a commercial condition.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西面对面摆着互换，一样只有在另一样出示时才交出；同一个姿态成了商业条件。

intro.en: Against is not a separate ancient word but a form of again: an adverbial genitive ending and a final consonant turned one word into two.
intro.cn: against 并不是另一个古老的词，而是 again 的一个形式：一个副词属格词尾再加一个词尾辅音，把同一个词分成了两个。

items.en: A reconstructed form *gagana is generally taken to mean 'against, opposite'; the deeper Indo-European source is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始日耳曼语的重构形式 *gagana 表示「相对、迎着」；更早的印欧语来源不确定。

items.en: Ongean meant 'towards, against, opposite' and also 'in return, back', and it is the direct ancestor of both again and against.
items.cn: ongean 表示「朝向、相对、迎面」，也表示「回报、返回」，它是 again 与 against 共同的直接祖先。

items.en: An adverbial genitive ending -es was added to the worn-down stem, producing againes, used where a preposition of opposition was needed.
items.cn: 在磨损后的词干上加副词属格词尾 -es，造出 againes，用在需要表示「相对」的介词位置。

items.en: A later excrescent -t was added to againes, giving against; the -t has no meaning and appears in other English words for the same mechanical reason.
items.cn: 后来在 againes 后加上赘音 -t，形成 against；这个 -t 没有意义，英语里另一些词也因同样的机械原因多出这个词尾。

items.en: The split is complete: again covers repetition and return, while against covers opposition, contact, contrast and protection.
items.cn: 分工至此完成：again 管重复与返回，against 管反对、抵住、对比与防备。

note.en: The look-alike group holds forms of the same old word plus two words that merely look similar; the near-meaning group holds prepositions of opposition, contrast and contact.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个古词的形式，另收两个只是拼写相近的词；近义组收表示反对、对比与相邻的介词。

entries.definition: The adverb of repetition and return from which against was formed; one word in Old English, two in Middle English.
entries.definitionCN: 表示重复与返回的副词，against 正由它演变而来；古英语里是一个词，中古英语分成两个。

entries.definition: A formal verb meaning to deny or contradict, built with the same Germanic element for 'against'.
entries.definitionCN: 正式动词，义为「否认、反驳」，用的是同一个日耳曼语「相对」成分。

entries.definition: To obtain or win; it only looks like the second half of against and comes from Old French.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「获得、收益」；只是拼写与 against 的后半截相近，词源不同，来自古法语。

entries.definition: Profitable or paid, formed from gain; unrelated to against beyond the look of the spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有收益的、有报酬的」，由 gain 构成，与 against 只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: Against, chiefly in contests and legal cases; narrower than against and mostly written as v.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「对、与……相对」，多用于比赛与诉讼，范围比 against 窄，常缩写成 v.

entries.definition: In opposition to a rule, fact or expectation; formal in tone and close to the rule sense of against.
entries.definitionCN: 短语介词，义为「与……相反」，语气正式，接近 against 的「违反」义。

entries.definition: Facing something, especially across a space; it gives the spatial picture without the hostility.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或形容词，义为「在……对面」，给出空间上的相对关系，但不含敌意。

entries.definition: Next to and along the side of something; it covers contact without pressure.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……旁边」，只表示相邻，不含压上去的力。

entries.definition: In spite of; it marks an obstacle that does not block the action, a formal cousin of the opposition sense.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或副词，义为「尽管」，标出并不构成阻碍的障碍，是「反对」义在正式文体里的远亲。

normalIntro.en: These hooks rely on the real shared history with again and on the phrases the word actually forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子依靠的是它与 again 真实共有的历史，以及这个词真实构成的搭配。

normal.en: Old English ongean became both again and against; the longer form took the hostile senses.
normal.cn: 古英语 ongean 分出了 again 与 against，较长的那个形式拿走了带敌意的义项。

normal.en: Against the wall is the posture of a body letting a surface hold it up.
normal.cn: against the wall 是让墙面托住身体的姿态。

normal.en: Vote against: you stand face to face with a proposal and say no.
normal.cn: vote against 就是与提案面对面站着说不。

normal.en: Insure against: you face the direction the loss would come from.
normal.cn: insure against 就是面朝损失可能来的方向站好。

normal.en: Against the law: the rule is a line in front of you, and you crossed it.
normal.cn: against the law：规则是面前的一条线，而你越了过去。

abstract.en: Two mirrors set face to face show the same image forever, which is the bare picture of against.
abstract.cn: 两面相对的镜子无限映出同一个影像，这正是 against 最赤裸的画面。

abstract.en: A sail filled by a wind blowing straight at it turns resistance into motion.
abstract.cn: 帆被迎面吹来的风鼓满，把阻力变成了前进的力。

abstract.en: A ladder rests on a wall: pressure without conflict, the same contact in a peaceful form.
abstract.cn: 梯子靠在墙上：有压力却无冲突，是同一个接触关系的和平版本。

examples.en: The council voted against building a new car park.
examples.cn: 议会投票反对修建新的停车场。

examples.en: Rain beat against the window all night.
examples.cn: 雨整夜打在窗户上。

examples.en: You should check these figures against the original report.
examples.cn: 你应该把这些数字与原始报告核对一遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额盖恩斯特」——额头抵着墙，半步不退：反对；靠着。

root: 古英语 ongean「朝向、相对」的属格副词形式 againes 再加赘音 -t，成为 against。ongean 一般认为来自原始日耳曼语重构形式 *gagana「相对、迎着」，更早的印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of against all reuse one posture: two things set face to face. Whether the facing is hostile, resting, competing, contrasting, guarding, forbidden or exchanging depends only on the situation.
sensesIntro.cn: against 的七个义项都在重复同一个姿态：两样东西面对面。面对面是敌对、倚靠、竞争、对比、防卫、违规还是交换，只取决于场合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two surfaces standing face to face and pressing together.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个面正对着，彼此抵住。

branches.en: OPPOSITION: the facing posture read as hostility towards a plan or person.
branches.cn: 反对线：把面对面的姿态读成对方案或人的敌意。

branches.en: CONTACT: the same posture with hostility removed, weight resting on a surface.
branches.cn: 接触线：同样的姿态去掉敌意，把重量交给一个表面。

branches.en: CONTEST: two sides facing each other across a match or a fight.
branches.cn: 竞争线：两方隔着比赛或战斗彼此相对。

branches.en: CONTRAST: one thing seen against another and judged by the difference.
branches.cn: 对比线：一样东西对着另一样被看见，靠差别来评判。

branches.en: RULES AND EXCHANGE: standing in the way of harm, crossing a line, or handing one thing over for another.
branches.cn: 规则与交换：挡在损害前面、越过一条线，或拿一样东西换另一样。

intro.en: Against is one worn-down Old English word plus two endings, and English and Latin both have prefixes that carry the same 'against' idea.
intro.cn: against 是一个磨损的古英语词加两个词尾，英语与拉丁语里也都有表示「相对」的前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin words below match the meaning of against but are not its etymological relatives; they are listed as semantic counterparts, not as cognates.
latinIntro.cn: 下面这些拉丁词在意义上与 against 对应，但并不是它的同源词；列为意义对照，而非同族词。

items.example: It opens the old form ongean.
items.exampleCN: 它是古词形 ongean 的开头。

items.example: It carries the facing sense of the whole word.
items.exampleCN: 它承担整个词「迎面相对」的意思。

items.example: It also appears inside gainsay.
items.exampleCN: 它也出现在 gainsay 里面。

items.example: It turned the stem into againes.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成 againes。

items.example: It turned againes into against.
items.exampleCN: 它把 againes 变成了 against。

items.example: It forms thereagainst in legal writing.
items.exampleCN: 它在法律文本中构成 thereagainst。

items.example: It forms counterattack and countermeasure.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 counterattack 与 countermeasure。

items.example: It forms antisocial and antibiotic.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 antisocial 与 antibiotic。

items.example: It forms obstacle, something standing in the way.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 obstacle，即挡在路上的东西。

definition_zh: 年龄；年纪；时代；时期；老年；长久；一代人；变老；使显老；成熟、陈化；法定年龄
definition_en: the number of years a person or thing has lived or existed, a period of history, the later part of life, or the process of becoming old
core_image: 树桩上的年轮，一圈一圈记下已经过去的时间
scene: 老人翻开相册，指着照片里穿校服的自己笑。She has aged a little since that photograph was taken.
sceneCN: 这里 aged 是「变老」（第 5 个义项：动词 age 的过去分词，指人逐渐显出老态）；句意为自那张照片拍下以来，她老了一些。画面里是相册、旧照片与老人翻页的手。

pos.zh: 名词：年龄；时代；老年；长久；法定年龄
动词：变老；使显老；成熟、陈化

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「年老的；陈化的」
由本词加 -less 构成，义为「不显老的；永恒的」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「老化；陈化过程」
由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「年龄歧视」
由 teen 与 age 复合而成，义为「十几岁的；青少年的」

senses.title: How many years someone has lived
senses.definition: the number of years that a person or thing has lived or existed
senses.definitionCN: 一个人或一件东西已经存活或存在过的年数
senses.example: She started school at the age of six.
senses.exampleCN: 她六岁开始上学。
senses.why: Latin aetas meant both a stretch of time and a stage of life, so the word first names the length of time already lived, not the birthday itself.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aetas 兼指「一段时间」与「人生的阶段」，因此这个词首先指的是已经活过的时间长度，而不是生日那一天。

senses.title: A named period of history
senses.definition: a particular period of history, or a stage in the development of something
senses.definitionCN: 历史上某个特定时期，或某事物发展中的某个阶段
senses.example: The invention of printing ended the age of hand-copied books.
senses.exampleCN: 印刷术的发明结束了手抄书的时代。
senses.why: Take the span of one lifetime and stretch it over a whole culture, and the span becomes a named period with a beginning and an end.
senses.whyCN: 把一个人的一生拉长到整个文化上，这段时间就成了一段有起有止、可以命名的时期。

senses.title: The later part of life
senses.definition: the last part of a person's life, when that person is old
senses.definitionCN: 一个人生命的后段，即年纪已大的时期
senses.example: He spent his old age in a village by the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 他在海边的一个村子里度过了晚年。
senses.why: If the word measures how much time has passed, then its far end is itself a place to stand: the years when the count is highest.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词计量已经过去多少时间，那么它的末端本身就是一个可以停留的位置：数字最大的那些年。

senses.title: A very long time
senses.definition: a very long time, especially in the spoken plural phrase for ages
senses.definitionCN: 很长的一段时间，尤用于口语复数短语 for ages
senses.example: I have not seen her for ages.
senses.exampleCN: 我很久没见过她了。
senses.why: Detach the measure of a lifetime from any particular person and it turns into a vague long stretch; the plural makes the length deliberately indefinite.
senses.whyCN: 把「一生」这把尺子从具体的人身上抽掉，它就变成一段含糊的长时光；复数让这个长度故意说不清。

senses.title: To grow old
senses.definition: to become older, or to show the visible signs of becoming older
senses.definitionCN: 年纪增长，或显露出变老的迹象
senses.example: He aged quickly after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 那次事故之后他老得很快。
senses.why: The noun turned verb names the measured time itself moving: the count rises, and the body records the rise.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成动词，指被计量的时间本身在走：数字往上加，身体也把这次上升记录下来。

senses.title: To make someone look older
senses.definition: to make a person look or seem older than they really are
senses.definitionCN: 使某人看上去比实际年龄更大
senses.example: That short haircut ages him by ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 那个短发发型让他看上去老了十岁。
senses.why: The same verb with an object puts the change on the other side of the relation: something outside the person adds years to the face.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词带上宾语，就把变化放到关系的另一侧：人之外的东西给这张脸添了岁数。

senses.title: To mature or ripen
senses.definition: to develop a full flavour or quality over time, said of cheese, wine and similar products
senses.definitionCN: 经过时间发展出完整风味或品质，用于奶酪、葡萄酒之类
senses.example: The cheese is aged in a cool cellar for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 这种奶酪在阴凉的地窖里陈放两年。
senses.why: Time does not only wear things down; in food and drink it also finishes them, so the same word covers ageing that is wanted rather than feared.
senses.whyCN: 时间不只磨损东西；在食物与酒里，它也会把东西做完，所以同一个词也管那种被期待而不是被害怕的「变老」。

senses.title: The legal age for adult rights
senses.definition: the age at which the law allows a person to do something, as in come of age and under age
senses.definitionCN: 法律允许某人做某事的年龄，如短语 come of age 与 under age
senses.example: In this country you cannot vote until you come of age.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个国家，未到法定年龄不能投票。
senses.why: Law turns the plain count of years into a threshold: at a stated number a person steps from one legal status into another.
senses.whyCN: 法律把单纯的岁数变成一道门槛：到规定的数字，人就从一种法律身份跨进另一种。

intro.en: Age reached English from Latin by way of Old French, and the whole family circles around the Latin noun for a span of time.
intro.cn: age 经古法语从拉丁语进入英语，整个词族都围绕拉丁语中那个表示「一段时间」的名词。

items.en: Aetas meant 'age, lifetime, a period of time' and also 'a stage of life'; it is generally connected with aevum 'everlasting time'.
items.cn: aetas 表示「年岁、一生、一段时间」，也指「人生的阶段」；一般认为它与 aevum「长久的时间」同出一系。

items.en: A derived form *aetaticum, reconstructed rather than recorded, is generally taken to mean 'of age, belonging to an age'; it is the form behind the French word.
items.cn: 一般认为俗拉丁语的派生形式 *aetaticum 表示「与年岁有关的」；这是重构形式，没有文献记录，却是法语词的来源。

items.en: Old French aage, later spelled eage, carried the senses 'age, lifetime, old age' into English.
items.cn: 古法语 aage（后来写作 eage）把「年龄、一生、老年」这些义项带进英语。

items.en: The noun is recorded in English from the thirteenth century; the 'historical period' sense is later, and exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个名词自十三世纪起在英语中有记录；「历史时期」的义项出现更晚，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The verb appears in the fifteenth century; the sense 'ripen, mature' develops later, giving aged cheese and aged wine.
items.cn: 动词见于十五世纪；「成熟、陈化」的义项后来又长出来，于是有了陈年奶酪与陈年葡萄酒。

note.en: The look-alike group holds forms built from this word, plus one adverb that only resembles it; the near-meaning group holds words for periods of time and for a lifetime.
note.cn: 形近组收由这个词构成的派生形式，另收一个只是长得像的副词；近义组收表示时间段与寿命的词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning old, or matured by keeping, formed from age plus -ed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「年老的」或「陈化的」，由 age 加 -ed 构成。

entries.definition: Never looking old, or never ending; age plus the suffix -less.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不显老的、永恒的」，由 age 加后缀 -less 构成。

entries.definition: Unfair treatment of people because of how old they are; age plus the suffix -ism.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「年龄歧视」，由 age 加后缀 -ism 构成。

entries.definition: Before the present time, as in two days ago; it merely looks similar and comes from a verb meaning to go by.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以前」，如两天前；只是拼写与 age 相近，词源不同，来自表示「过去、走完」的动词。

entries.definition: A long period of history with a particular character; it needs no person to measure.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「时代、纪元」，指有某种特征的长时期，不必以人的年岁为尺度。

entries.definition: A period marked by a striking event that starts something new; sharper and more technical than age.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「纪元、重大时期」，以某个划时代事件为起点，比 age 更尖锐、更专业。

entries.definition: Any length of time, long or short, named or unnamed; the plainest and most neutral word of the group.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「时期、一段时间」，长短与是否命名都无所谓，是这一组里最中性的词。

entries.definition: The length of time a person or thing is expected to live; it measures the whole stretch that age counts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「寿命」，指一个人或事物预期能活的时间，正是 age 所计量的整段长度。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin noun aetas, the family built on age, and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子使用真实的拉丁名词 aetas、由 age 构成的词族，以及这个词真实出现的搭配。

normal.en: Aetas is a span of time, so one word covers both a person's years and a whole era.
normal.cn: aetas 是一段时间，所以同一个词既管一个人的岁数，也管一整个时代。

normal.en: At the age of is the plain count; the age of printing is the same count stretched over a culture.
normal.cn: at the age of 是单纯的计数；the age of printing 是同一个计数被拉长到整个文化上。

normal.en: For ages means a number of years so large that nobody bothers to state it.
normal.cn: for ages 指年数多到没人愿意说清，所以就是「很久」。

normal.en: Come of age is the moment the count reaches the number the law requires.
normal.cn: come of age 就是计数达到法律要求的那个数字的时刻。

normal.en: Aged cheese is time doing useful work, not time doing damage.
normal.cn: aged cheese 是时间在做有用的事，而不是在搞破坏。

abstract.en: Count the rings in a cut stump: each ring is one year, and the whole stack is an age.
abstract.cn: 数一数树桩上的年轮：一圈是一年，整摞就是一段年岁。

abstract.en: An hourglass turned over and over: the same sand measures a minute, a life or a civilization.
abstract.cn: 一只反复翻转的沙漏：同一堆沙可以量一分钟、一生，也可以量一个文明。

abstract.en: An old suitcase covered in travel labels: every label is a period, and the case itself is the age that holds them.
abstract.cn: 一只贴满旅行标签的旧皮箱：每个标签都是一个时期，箱子本身就是装下这些时期的年岁。

examples.en: She learned to swim at the age of five.
examples.cn: 她五岁时学会了游泳。

examples.en: These stone tools belong to a much earlier age.
examples.cn: 这些石制工具属于一个早得多的时代。

examples.en: He has aged visibly since he lost his job.
examples.cn: 自从失业以来，他明显见老了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶吉」——诶，年纪一大把，都成一个时代了：年龄；时代。

root: 古法语 aage（现代法语 âge）源自拉丁语 aetas「年岁、一生、一段时间」，一般认为其俗拉丁派生形式为重构的 *aetaticum；aetas 又与 aevum「长久的时间」同出一系，更早的印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of age all measure the same thing from different distances: a count of years on one body, the same span laid over a culture, its far end, a vague long stretch, the process of moving along it, and the legal line drawn across it.
sensesIntro.cn: age 的八个义项都在量同一件东西，只是距离不同：一个人身上的年数、铺到整个文化上的同一段时间、它的末端、含糊的一大段、沿着它移动的过程，以及横在它上面的法律界线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of tree rings, each ring one year, the whole stack one life.
core.cn: 核心意象：一摞年轮，一圈是一年，整摞就是一生。

branches.en: THE BODY: the count of years attached to one person or thing.
branches.cn: 身体线：附着在一个人或一件东西上的年数。

branches.en: HISTORY: the same span stretched over a culture and given a name.
branches.cn: 历史线：同一段时间铺到整个文化上，并得到名称。

branches.en: THE TWO ENDS: the far end of the count is old age, while a loose plural makes any long stretch for ages.
branches.cn: 两端线：计数的远端是晚年，而松散的复数把任意长的一段说成 for ages。

branches.en: THE PROCESS: the verb sets time moving, either in the person or through something that makes the person look older.
branches.cn: 过程线：动词让时间动起来，或在人身上动，或借外物让人显老。

branches.en: TIME COMPLETES AND TIME QUALIFIES: ripening is ageing that is wanted, and the legal age is ageing turned into a threshold.
branches.cn: 完成与资格：陈化是被期待的变老，法定年龄则是变老被变成一道门槛。

intro.en: Age is a Latin noun filtered through French, with English suffixes building the modern family.
intro.cn: age 是经法语过滤的拉丁名词，英语再用后缀扩出现代词族。

latinIntro.en: Aetas, aevum and aeternus are recorded Latin words; only the intermediate Vulgar Latin form is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: aetas、aevum、aeternus 都是有记录的拉丁词，只有中间的俗拉丁形式属于重构。

items.example: It is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 它是整个词族的源头。

items.example: It formed the reconstructed *aetaticum.
items.exampleCN: 它构成了重构形式 *aetaticum。

items.example: It carried the Latin noun into English.
items.exampleCN: 它把这个拉丁名词带进了英语。

items.example: It forms aged.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 aged。

items.example: It forms ageless.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 ageless。

items.example: It forms ageism.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 ageism。

items.meaningCN: 过程或正在进行的动作
items.example: It forms ageing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 ageing。

items.example: It combines with age to form teenage.
items.exampleCN: 它与 age 复合成 teenage。

items.example: It combines with age to form old age.
items.exampleCN: 它与 age 组合成 old age。

definition_zh: 代理机构；代理公司；中介；（政府）机构；能动性；中介作用；代理权
definition_en: a business or organization that provides a service for others, an official body with a particular duty, or the power and means of acting
core_image: 一只手把另一只手引到台前：事情由别人代你去办
scene: 凌晨的编辑部里，记者把刚写好的稿子交给通讯社的值班员。The news agency sent the story to every member paper.
sceneCN: 这里 agency 是「代理机构、通讯社」（第 1 个义项：替别人提供服务并代为发布的机构）；句意为这家通讯社把这篇报道发给了每一家成员报纸。画面里是夜间的编辑部、成排的稿纸与值班电话。

pos.zh: 名词：代理机构；政府机构；能动性；代理权

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「代理的；施动的」
由本词加前缀 inter- 构成，义为「跨机构的；机构之间的」
由本词加前缀 sub- 构成，义为「分代理处；分社」

senses.title: A business that acts for clients
senses.definition: a business that provides a particular service for other people or companies
senses.definitionCN: 为其他人或公司提供某项服务的商业机构
senses.example: She booked the flights through a travel agency.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过一家旅行社订了机票。
senses.why: Latin agere means to do or drive, and this noun names the office where the doing is carried out on someone else's behalf: the client hands the action over.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 agere 意为「做、驱动」，这个名词指「替别人做事的办事处」：委托人把「做」这件事交了出去。

senses.title: An official body of the state
senses.definition: an official organization, often part of a government, with a particular duty
senses.definitionCN: 承担某项专门职责的官方组织，常为政府的一部分
senses.example: The environmental agency ordered tests of the river water.
senses.exampleCN: 环保机构下令检测河水。
senses.why: A public body is also an office of doing: the state sets up a unit whose entire job is to carry out one kind of action.
senses.whyCN: 公共机构同样是「办事的处所」：国家设立一个单位，它的全部工作就是执行某一类行动。

senses.title: The capacity to act
senses.definition: the capacity of a person or group to act and make choices, especially in social science
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体行动并作出选择的能力，尤用于社会科学
senses.example: The study asks how much agency tenants have in shaping housing policy.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究追问租户在影响住房政策上有多少能动性。
senses.why: Take the office away and what is left is the bare capacity to do; this abstract sense is agere turned into a noun with no institution attached.
senses.whyCN: 把「办事处」这层机构拿走，剩下的就是「做」的能力；这个抽象义就是 agere 变成名词后不再挂靠任何机构。

senses.title: Action through a means
senses.definition: the means by which something is done, especially in the formal phrase by the agency of
senses.definitionCN: 某事得以完成所凭借的手段，尤用于正式短语 by the agency of
senses.example: The disease spread by the agency of contaminated water.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病经由受污染的水传播。
senses.why: When one thing produces an effect, it acts as the doer for another, so the word comes to mean the channel through which an effect is carried.
senses.whyCN: 当一样东西产生某种效果时，它就替另一方充当了「执行者」，于是这个词也指效果借以传出的通道。

senses.title: The authority to represent another
senses.definition: the position, authority or business of representing another person or company
senses.definitionCN: 代表另一个人或公司行事的职位、权限或业务
senses.example: The firm holds an agency for three European brands.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司持有三个欧洲品牌的代理权。
senses.why: Behind the institution lies a legal arrangement: one party is authorised to act for another, which is exactly what agere means in legal Latin.
senses.whyCN: 机构背后是一种法律安排：一方获准替另一方行事，这正是法律拉丁语里 agere 的意思。

intro.en: Agency is the abstract noun of a Latin verb for doing, carried into English through French; the office and the capacity to act come from the same stem.
intro.cn: agency 是拉丁语中表示「做」的动词的抽象名词，经法语进入英语；「机构」与「行动能力」出自同一个词干。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion'; its present participle agens, stem agent-, named the one who does.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、使动起来」；它的现在分词 agens 词干为 agent-，用来指「做事的人」。

items.en: The late Latin noun agentia meant 'action, doing' and also 'the office of one who acts for another'; it is recorded, not reconstructed.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语名词 agentia 表示「行动、做事」，也指「代为行事者的职务」；它有文献记录，不是重构形式。

items.en: French agence carried the word towards English with the sense of an office or a way of acting.
items.cn: 法语 agence 把这个词带向英语，带有「办事处」与「行事方式」的意思。

items.en: The commercial sense 'a business acting for clients' is recorded from the seventeenth century; the philosophical sense 'capacity to act' is far later, and exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 「替客户办事的商业机构」这一义项自十七世纪起有记录；「行动能力」的哲学义出现得晚得多，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Government agencies, news agencies and the abstract talk of human agency now sit side by side, all from the same verb of doing.
items.cn: 政府机构、通讯社与关于人的能动性的抽象讨论如今并存，全都出自同一个表示「做」的动词。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same Latin verb of doing, plus one noun that merely rhymes in spelling; the near-meaning group holds institutions and words for the power to act.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「做」动词的词族，另收一个只是拼写相像的名词；近义组收机构类词与表示行动能力的词。

entries.definition: The person who acts for another, built directly on the Latin participle stem agent-.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「代理人」，直接由拉丁分词词干 agent- 构成，是 agency 的同根词。

entries.definition: A list of things to be done, from a Latin form of the same verb agere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「议程、待办事项」，来自同一个动词 agere 的拉丁形式，本义是「该做的事」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning relating to an agent or to action, formed from agency with -al.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「代理的、施动的」，由 agency 加 -al 构成。

entries.definition: The state of needing immediate attention; only its ending looks like agency, and it comes from a Latin verb meaning to press.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「紧急、急迫」；只是词尾与 agency 相近，词源不同，来自表示「压、催」的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: An office or a department, especially a government one; it names the room rather than the delegated action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「办事处、局」，多指政府部门；它强调的是办公场所，而不是被托付的行动。

entries.definition: An established organization or custom; broader than agency and not limited to service work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「机构、制度」，比 agency 更宽，不限于服务性工作。

entries.definition: A business company; commercial in tone and silent about whether it acts for clients.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「公司、商行」，语气偏商业，不说明是否替客户办事。

entries.definition: The ability to act first without being told; close to the abstract sense of agency but personal in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「主动性、首创精神」，接近 agency 的抽象义，但更强调个人的主动。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb agere and the everyday compounds the word forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子使用真实的拉丁动词 agere，以及这个词构成的各种日常复合形式。

normal.en: Agere is to do; an agent is the one who does, and an agency is the office where the doing happens.
normal.cn: agere 是「做」；agent 是做事的人，agency 是做事的那间办公室。

normal.en: A travel agency does the booking so that you do not have to stand in the queue.
normal.cn: travel agency 替你把票订好，你不必自己去排队。

normal.en: A news agency does the gathering and sends the result to papers that cannot be everywhere.
normal.cn: news agency 替人跑现场，再把结果发给无法到处派人的报纸。

normal.en: By the agency of means through the working of something, as in a disease carried by water.
normal.cn: by the agency of 意为「借助某物的作用」，例如经由水传播的疾病。

normal.en: Human agency is simply people's own power to do something about their situation.
normal.cn: human agency 就是人自己动手改变处境的能力。

abstract.en: One hand guides another hand to sign: the signature is real, but the acting hand belongs to someone else.
abstract.cn: 一只手引着另一只手签字：签名是真的，动的那只手却属于别人。

abstract.en: A switchboard connecting a call: the caller and the answerer never touch, yet the connection is the work.
abstract.cn: 总机把一通电话接上：主叫与被叫从不接触，而接通本身就是那份工作。

abstract.en: A stand-in on a stage: the body is visible, the authority is borrowed.
abstract.cn: 舞台上的替身：身体看得见，权限却是借来的。

examples.en: We rented the flat through a local agency.
examples.cn: 我们通过当地一家中介租下了这套公寓。

examples.en: Two government agencies are investigating the spill.
examples.cn: 两个政府机构正在调查这次泄漏。

examples.en: Children need room to exercise their own agency.
examples.cn: 孩子需要空间去行使自己的能动性。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶珍西」——诶，珍西替你把事情办了：代理机构。

root: 拉丁语 agere「做、驱动」的现在分词词干 agent- 加名词后缀构成晚期拉丁语 agentia「行动、办事、代理职务」，经法语 agence 进入英语；核心始终是「替人行事」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of agency all come from one verb of doing: a business that does for clients, a state body that does one kind of work, the bare capacity to do, the channel through which an effect is done, and the legal right to do for another.
sensesIntro.cn: agency 的五个义项都出自同一个表示「做」的动词：替客户做事的商号、专做一类事的国家机构、单纯的做事能力、效果借以传出的通道，以及替他人行事的法定权限。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand guides another hand to sign a document.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手引着另一只手在文件上签字。

branches.en: SERVICE: the office where the doing is done for paying clients.
branches.cn: 服务线：替付费客户做事的那个办事处。

branches.en: STATE: the same office, set up by government to carry out one kind of action.
branches.cn: 国家线：同一个办事处，由政府设立，专做一类行动。

branches.en: CAPACITY: the institution removed, leaving only the power to act.
branches.cn: 能力线：把机构拿走，只剩下行动的力量。

branches.en: CHANNEL: one thing doing for another, so the word means the means by which an effect travels.
branches.cn: 通道线：一样东西替另一样起作用，于是这个词指效果传递所凭借的手段。

branches.en: AUTHORITY: the legal right that lets one party act in the name of another.
branches.cn: 权限线：让一方以另一方名义行事的法定权利。

intro.en: Agency is a Latin verb stem plus abstract endings, with English prefixes and suffixes extending the family.
intro.cn: agency 是拉丁动词词干加抽象名词词尾，英语再用前缀与后缀扩展这个词族。

latinIntro.en: Agere, agens and agentia are all recorded in Latin; no form in this family is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、agens、agentia 在拉丁语中都有记录，这个词族里没有重构形式。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English noun.

definition_zh: 代理人；经纪人；特工；探员；作用剂；动因；（语法）施事者
definition_en: a person who acts for another, someone who works secretly for a government, a substance that produces an effect, or the doer of an action
core_image: 一枚被派出去办事的棋子：动手的是它，主意却来自别处
scene: 演出结束后，剧场经理把下一季的合约交给坐在后台的经纪人。Her agent called to say the tour was cancelled.
sceneCN: 这里 agent 是「经纪人」（第 2 个义项：替艺人出面谈事务并从中抽成的中介人）；句意为她的经纪人打电话来说巡演取消了。画面里是后台的化妆镜、摊开的合约与电话。

pos.zh: 名词：代理人；经纪人；特工；作用剂；动因

collocations.zh: 可自由签约的球员；行动自由的人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -ive 构成，义为「施事的；带施事标记的」
由本词加后缀 -less 构成，义为「无施事者的」
由本词加前缀 sub- 构成，义为「分代理人；次级代理」
同根抽象名词，来自同一拉丁词干 agent-，义为「代理机构；能动性」

senses.title: One who acts for another
senses.definition: a person who is authorised to act for another person or organization
senses.definitionCN: 获授权代表另一个人或组织行事的人
senses.example: He signed the contract as the agent of the owner.
senses.exampleCN: 他作为业主的代理人签了这份合同。
senses.why: From agere 'to do': an agent is the one doing, and in this sense the doing belongs to someone else who has handed it over.
senses.whyCN: 来自 agere「做」：agent 就是「在做的那一个」，而这个义项里，所做的事属于把事交出来的另一个人。

senses.title: A business intermediary
senses.definition: a person or firm that arranges business for others, such as a travel or estate agent
senses.definitionCN: 替他人安排事务的人或商号，如旅行代理或房产经纪
senses.example: The agent found a buyer within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 经纪人一周之内就找到了买家。
senses.why: The same delegated doing, moved into the market: the intermediary performs the searching and bargaining that the client does not want to do in person.
senses.whyCN: 同样是受托的「做」，只是搬到了市场上：中介替客户完成他不愿亲自去做的寻找与讨价还价。

senses.title: A secret agent
senses.definition: a person who works secretly for a government or an intelligence service
senses.definitionCN: 为政府或情报机构秘密工作的人
senses.example: The agent had been passing documents for years.
senses.exampleCN: 那名特工多年来一直在传递文件。
senses.why: Here the delegate acts in the name of a state but must not be seen doing it; the action is real while the identity is false.
senses.whyCN: 这里的受派者以国家名义行事，却不能被人看见在行事；行动是真的，身份是假的。

senses.title: An officer of the law
senses.definition: an officer of a law-enforcement body such as a federal bureau of investigation
senses.definitionCN: 执法机构中的办案人员，如联邦调查局的探员
senses.example: A federal agent questioned the witnesses at the depot.
senses.exampleCN: 一名联邦探员在仓库询问了证人。
senses.why: The delegated action here is official inquiry: the state's power to investigate is carried out by one named person on the ground.
senses.whyCN: 这里受派的行动是官方查问：国家的调查权由一个具名的、在现场的人执行。

senses.title: A substance that produces an effect
senses.definition: a substance or force that produces a particular effect
senses.definitionCN: 能产生某种特定效果的物质的或物理的作用物
senses.example: The laboratory tested a new cleaning agent on the stained cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室在沾污的布上测试了一种新的清洁剂。
senses.why: The person drops out and only the doing remains: whatever produces the effect is 'the one doing', even when it is a liquid or a beam of light.
senses.whyCN: 人退场了，只剩「做」：凡产生效果的东西都成了「行为者」，哪怕它是一瓶液体或一束光。

senses.title: A cause of change
senses.definition: a person or thing that causes something to happen or change
senses.definitionCN: 使某事发生或改变的人或事物
senses.example: Cheap printing was the chief agent of change in that century.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价的印刷是那个世纪最主要的变革推动者。
senses.why: Pull the delegated doer out of any institution and it becomes a general cause: anything that makes an effect happen can be called its agent.
senses.whyCN: 把「受派的行事者」从机构中抽出来，它就成了一般的原因：凡是让某种效果发生的，都可以称为它的 agent。

senses.title: The doer in grammar
senses.definition: the person or thing that performs the action of a verb, especially in a passive construction
senses.definitionCN: 执行动词所表动作的人或物，尤见于被动结构
senses.example: In the sentence about the broken window, the storm is the agent.
senses.exampleCN: 在关于窗户被打破的那个句子里，风暴就是施事者。
senses.why: Grammar borrows the word at its most literal: the participant that does the action, whether named or left out, is the agent of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 语法把这个词按最字面的意思借去：执行动作的那一方，不论写出来还是被省略，都是动词的施事。

intro.en: Agent is the Latin participle for 'doing' used as a noun, and English took it over almost unchanged.
intro.cn: agent 是拉丁语中表示「正在做」的分词被当作名词使用，英语几乎是原样接了过来。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion' and is the verb behind a large family of English words.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、使动起来」，是英语一大批词背后的动词。

items.en: The present participle agens, stem agent-, meant 'doing' and, used as a noun, 'the one who does'; it is recorded, not reconstructed.
items.cn: 现在分词 agens 词干为 agent-，意为「正在做的」，作名词时指「正在做事的人」；它有文献记录，不是重构形式。

items.en: In medieval Latin the noun was used for a person who manages business or acts in another's name.
items.cn: 在中世纪拉丁语中，这个名词用于指管理事务或以他人名义行事的人。

items.en: The word enters English from Latin and French as a name for one who acts or does business for another; exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词经拉丁语与法语进入英语，指替他人行事或办事的人；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The intelligence sense is recorded in the nineteenth century and the chemical sense soon after; the grammatical sense grows out of the older philosophical use.
items.cn: 情报义在十九世纪有记录，化学义稍后出现；语法义则从更早的哲学用法中长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same Latin participle; the near-meaning group holds the many roles an agent can play, each narrower than the English word.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁分词的词族；近义组收 agent 可以扮演的各种角色，每一个都比这个英语词更窄。

entries.definition: The abstract noun and the name of the office, built on the same stem agent-.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「代理机构、能动性」，由同一个词干 agent- 构成，与 agent 同根。

entries.definition: Things to be done, from a Latin form of agere; the doing is still visible in the meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「议程、待办事项」，来自 agere 的拉丁形式，词义里仍看得见「要做的事」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning marking or relating to the doer, as in agentive suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「表示施事的」，如「施事后缀」，由 agent 加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: Needing immediate action; only the ending looks like agent, and it comes from a Latin verb meaning to press.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「紧急的」；只是词尾与 agent 相近，词源不同，来自表示「压、催」的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: A person chosen to speak or act for a group; broader and more public than agent.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「代表」，指被选出替群体说话或行事的人，比 agent 更公开。

entries.definition: A middleman who arranges deals between two sides and takes a fee.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「经纪人、中间人」，专门撮合双方交易并收取费用。

entries.definition: A person who secretly gathers information, usually for a state; plainer and more hostile than secret agent.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「间谍」，指秘密搜集情报的人，通常为国家服务，语气比 secret agent 更直白。

entries.definition: A person appointed to act for a superior when needed; it stresses rank rather than delegation of business.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「副手、代理人」，指在需要时代替上级行事的人，强调的是职级而非事务托付。

entries.definition: A substance used in a chemical test because of how it reacts; close to the chemical sense but limited to laboratory use.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「试剂」，指因反应特性而用于化学检验的物质，接近 agent 的化学义，但限于实验室用途。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin participle agens and the compounds the word actually forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子使用真实的拉丁分词 agens，以及这个词真实构成的复合形式。

normal.en: Agens is simply 'the one doing', so an agent is anyone or anything that acts in your place.
normal.cn: agens 就是「正在做的那个」，所以 agent 就是替你去做的任何人或任何东西。

normal.en: Agency is the office, agent is the person in it: same stem, two levels.
normal.cn: agency 是那间办事处，agent 是里面的人：同一个词干，两个层级。

normal.en: A secret agent does the state's work without appearing to do anything.
normal.cn: secret agent 替国家做事，却不能让人看出他在做事。

normal.en: A cleaning agent keeps only the doing and drops the person entirely.
normal.cn: cleaning agent 只保留「做」，把人完全去掉。

normal.en: An agent of change is whatever makes a period move in a new direction.
normal.cn: agent of change 就是让一个时期转向新方向的那个东西。

abstract.en: A chess piece moved across the board: it is the piece that moves, but the intention sits outside it.
abstract.cn: 一枚被推过棋盘的棋子：动的是它，意图却在它之外。

abstract.en: A mask with a voice behind it: the action is done in the open, the actor stays hidden.
abstract.cn: 一张面具后面有人声：事情公开做成了，做事的人却藏着。

abstract.en: A drop of liquid in a test tube changing colour: no will at all, yet it is the thing that acts.
abstract.cn: 试管里一滴液体让颜色改变：没有意志，却仍是在起作用的那一个。

examples.en: Our agent in the city handles all the paperwork.
examples.cn: 我们在城里的代理人处理所有文书工作。

examples.en: A mild soap is a safe cleaning agent for wool.
examples.cn: 温和的肥皂是羊毛的安全清洁剂。

examples.en: She was recruited as an agent by the intelligence service.
examples.cn: 她被情报机构招募为特工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶真特」——诶，真特替你跑腿办事：代理人。

root: 拉丁语 agere「做、驱动」的现在分词 agens（词干 agent-）直接进入英语，本义是「正在做事的人」，由此引申出代理人、中介、特工、作用剂、动因与语法上的施事者。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of agent all name a doer: one who does for a client, for a market, for a state in secret, for the law, for a chemical reaction, for a historical change, and finally the doer inside a sentence.
sensesIntro.cn: agent 的七个义项都在指「做事的那一个」：替客户做、替市场做、替国家秘密做、替执法机构做、在化学反应里做、在历史变化中做，最后是句子里的施事者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chess piece moved by a hand that stays outside the board.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚棋子被一只始终在棋盘之外的手推动。

branches.en: DELEGATION: legal and commercial acting for another, where the action is handed over.
branches.cn: 受托线：法律与商业上的代为行事，动作被交到别人手里。

branches.en: SERVICE: the delegate works secretly for a state, or openly for the law.
branches.cn: 公职线：受派者或秘密替国家工作，或公开替执法机构工作。

branches.en: SUBSTANCE: the person disappears and the effect alone remains as the doer.
branches.cn: 物质线：人消失了，只剩效果本身充当行为者。

branches.en: CAUSE: the delegate generalised into anything that makes a change happen.
branches.cn: 原因线：受派者被推广成任何使变化发生的东西。

branches.en: GRAMMAR: the doer named inside a sentence, with or without a preposition.
branches.cn: 语法线：句子内部被指明的那个施事者，带不带介词都可以。

intro.en: Agent is a Latin participle stem that English uses as a noun, with a small family built by ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: agent 是一个被英语用作名词的拉丁分词词干，加上普通后缀就长出一个小的词族。

latinIntro.en: Agere, agens and agentia are recorded Latin forms; nothing in this family is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、agens、agentia 都是有记录的拉丁形式，这个词族里没有重构形式。

definition_zh: 好斗的；侵略的；积极进取的；强势的；侵袭性的；强效的；激进的
definition_en: ready to attack or quarrel, forceful and determined in pursuing a goal, or strong and severe in its effects
core_image: 向前迈出一步，把身体逼到别人面前的那股劲
scene: 销售例会上，新来的主管把下季度目标写满整面白板，逐条压到每个小组头上。The firm launched an aggressive campaign to win younger customers.
sceneCN: 这里 aggressive 是「强势的、猛烈的」（第 4 个义项：营销与推销上的强硬做法）；句意为这家公司发起了一场猛烈的推广活动，以争取更年轻的顾客。白板上写满目标，会议室里气氛紧绷。

pos.zh: 形容词：好斗的、有攻击性的；侵略的；积极进取的；强势的

collocations.zh: 好斗的行为；攻击性行为
强势营销；猛烈的市场推广
爱抢道、开车很凶的司机

derivatives.zh: 与本源出拉丁语名词 aggressio，义为「侵略；攻击行为；（心理上的）攻击性」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「咄咄逼人地；强势地」
由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「好斗；攻击性；闯劲」
与本源出拉丁语动词 aggredi，义为「侵略者；挑衅者」

senses.title: Hostile and ready to attack
senses.definition: of a person or animal, angry and ready to attack or quarrel
senses.definitionCN: 指人或动物怒气冲冲、随时准备动手或争吵
senses.example: The dog became aggressive whenever a stranger came near the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 只要有陌生人靠近大门，那条狗就变得凶猛。
senses.why: Latin aggredi is ad- 'towards' plus gradi 'to step'; the word pictures a step taken at someone in order to strike.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aggredi 由 ad-「朝向」加 gradi「走、迈步」构成，词里画的是朝对方迈步逼近、准备动手的姿态，所以最先长出的是「好斗」这一具体义。

senses.title: Invading by force
senses.definition: of a country, an army or an action, using force to take over another place or to dominate others
senses.definitionCN: 指国家、军队或行动以武力侵占他处或压制他人
senses.example: The smaller nation condemned the aggressive moves along its border.
senses.exampleCN: 那个小国谴责邻国在其边境的侵略举动。
senses.why: Scale the same forward step up to an army: stepping into someone else's land is exactly what aggression looks like between states.
senses.whyCN: 把同一个「向前迈步」放大到军队身上：踏进别人的土地，正是国家之间所说的侵略，所以这一义项保留的仍是迈步逼近的动作，只是主体换成了军队。

senses.title: Forceful in pursuing success
senses.definition: very determined and energetic in trying to succeed, especially in business or sport
senses.definitionCN: 在争取成功时非常坚决、精力充沛，多用于商业或体育
senses.example: She is an aggressive saleswoman who calls twenty clients before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个干劲十足的销售员，中午前就给二十位客户打了电话。
senses.why: Take the hostility out of the step and what remains is pure forward drive, so the same energy is now praised instead of blamed.
senses.whyCN: 把「迈步逼近」里的敌意抽掉，剩下的就是纯粹的向前冲劲；同一股劲在这里不再被责备，反而成了褒义的「有闯劲」。

senses.title: Bold and hard-selling
senses.definition: of a marketing or sales method, bold, forceful and hard to ignore
senses.definitionCN: 指营销或推销手段大胆、强劲，让人难以忽视
senses.example: The startup grew through aggressive advertising rather than word of mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 这家初创企业靠猛烈的广告投放而不是口碑成长起来。
senses.why: Advertising that steps right up to the buyer and will not take no for an answer is the same forward step turned into a sales technique.
senses.whyCN: 广告径直走到买家面前、不肯接受拒绝，这就是把「向前迈步」做成了推销技术，所以营销语境里的强势只是同一个动作换了场地。

senses.title: Fast-spreading and hard to treat
senses.definition: of a disease or tumour, growing quickly and spreading in a way that is hard to control
senses.definitionCN: 指疾病或肿瘤发展迅速、扩散猛烈而难以控制
senses.example: Doctors found an aggressive form of cancer in his left lung.
senses.exampleCN: 医生在他的左肺发现了一种侵袭性很强的癌症。
senses.why: Medicine borrows the image of an enemy that advances without restraint: the growth attacks tissue the way an army attacks land.
senses.whyCN: 医学借用了「不顾一切向前推进的敌人」这一形象：病变侵犯组织，就像军队侵占土地，因此同样的「攻击」被用来描述病情的发展速度。

senses.title: Harsh in effect
senses.titleCN: 强效的；刺激性的（化学品）
senses.definition: of a chemical or cleaning product, strong enough to damage surfaces or skin
senses.definitionCN: 指化学品或清洁剂效力强到会损伤表面或皮肤
senses.example: Do not use an aggressive cleaner on the polished stone floor.
senses.exampleCN: 不要在抛光石地面上使用强效清洁剂。
senses.why: A substance that attacks dirt without mercy also attacks the surface beneath, so the word keeps its attacking core and aims it at materials.
senses.whyCN: 毫不留情地攻击污垢的东西，也会攻击下面的表面；词义仍保留「攻击」这个核心，只是对象从人换成了材料，于是有了「强效而伤物」的意思。

senses.title: Seeking high returns at high risk
senses.definition: of an investment plan or strategy, accepting high risk in order to aim for high returns
senses.definitionCN: 指投资计划或策略为追求高回报而承担高风险
senses.example: His portfolio is too aggressive for someone close to retirement.
senses.exampleCN: 对一个快要退休的人来说，他的投资组合过于激进。
senses.why: Finance takes the forward-charging step and measures it in risk: the investor who pushes hardest for gain also stands closest to loss.
senses.whyCN: 金融把「一路向前冲」换算成风险来计量：最拼命追收益的投资者，离亏损也最近，所以这股冲劲在投资语境里被叫作「激进」。

intro.en: Aggressive comes from Latin aggredi 'to go towards, attack', built on ad- 'towards' and gradi 'to walk, step'; English took the past-participle stem aggress-.
intro.cn: aggressive 来自拉丁语 aggredi「走向、攻击」，由 ad-「朝向」与 gradi「走、迈步」构成；英语取的是它的过去分词词干 aggress-。

items.en: The verb gradi meant 'to walk, step'; the related noun gradus meant 'a step'. Both are recorded Latin words, not reconstructions.
items.cn: 动词 gradi 意为「走、迈步」，相关名词 gradus 意为「一步、台阶」；两者都是有记录的拉丁语词，不是重构形式。

items.en: Ad- 'towards' plus gradi produced aggredi, 'to go towards, approach', which already in Latin could mean 'to set upon, attack'.
items.cn: ad-「朝向」加 gradi 构成 aggredi，意为「走向、接近」，在拉丁语中已经可以表示「扑向、攻击」。

items.en: The past participle aggressus 'having advanced against' and the later noun aggressio 'an attack' supply the stem aggress- that English uses.
items.cn: 过去分词 aggressus「已经逼近攻击的」与后起名词 aggressio「攻击」，提供了英语所用的词干 aggress-。

items.en: English aggressive is recorded in the eighteenth century in the sense 'tending to attack'; it may have come through French agressif, and exact first dates differ between sources.
items.cn: 英语 aggressive 于十八世纪有记录，意为「有攻击倾向的」；可能经法语 agressif 传入，确切首见年代各家记载不一。

items.en: In the twentieth century, especially in American business writing, the word gained the approving sense 'energetic and enterprising', and technical uses in medicine and finance followed.
items.cn: 二十世纪，尤其在美国商业写作中，这个词获得「积极进取、有闯劲」的褒义；医学与金融的技术用法随后出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin root gradi 'to step'; the near-meaning group gathers words for hostility, confidence and force, each with a different tone.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁词根 gradi「迈步」构成的一族词；近义组收表示敌意、自信与强力的词，彼此语气不同。

entries.definition: The noun for an unprovoked attack, or in psychology for hostile behaviour.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「侵略、攻击行为」，心理学中也指攻击性；与 aggressive 同出拉丁语动词 aggredi。

entries.definition: The person or country that starts an attack.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「侵略者、挑衅者」，指先动手的一方，与 aggressive 共享词干 aggress-。

entries.definition: The adverb: in a hostile or forceful manner.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「咄咄逼人地、强势地」，由本词加后缀 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: Movement forward or improvement; built on pro- 'forward' plus the same gradi.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「前进、进步」，由 pro-「向前」加同一个 gradi 构成，与 aggressive 共用「迈步」这一词根。

entries.definition: The act of going out, or a way out; e- 'out' plus the same gradi.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「外出、出口」，由 e-「向外」加同一个 gradi 构成，词根与 aggressive 相同而方向相反。

entries.definition: Unfriendly and showing dislike; it names the feeling, while aggressive names the readiness to act.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「敌对的、不友好的」，侧重心里的敌意，而 aggressive 侧重随时动手的架势。

entries.definition: Confidently stating one's views without attacking others; usually positive where aggressive is often negative.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「坚定自信的、敢于表达的」，不含攻击他人的意思，通常为褒义，而 aggressive 常带贬义。

entries.definition: Eager to fight, especially of a country or a person's tone; more formal and more clearly warlike.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「好战的、寻衅的」，多用于国家或说话语气，比 aggressive 更正式、战争意味更明确。

entries.definition: Strong and effective in action or speech, with no hint of hostility.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「强有力的、有说服力的」，只强调力量与效果，完全没有敌意。

entries.definition: Too eager to get what one wants, in a way that annoys people; informal.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「爱出风头、强人所难的」，指过分急于达到目的而令人反感，属口语用词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin parts ad- and gradi, the recorded family forms, and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁语部件 ad- 与 gradi、有记录的词族形式，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Ad- is 'towards' and gradi is 'to step': aggressive pictures one step taken straight at someone.
normal.cn: ad- 是「朝向」，gradi 是「迈步」：aggressive 画的就是朝某人径直迈出的一步。

normal.en: The same root appears in progress and egress, one stepping forward and one stepping out.
normal.cn: 同一词根还出现在 progress 与 egress 里，一个是向前迈，一个是向外迈。

normal.en: Aggression and aggressor keep the open hostility; aggressive can also be praise for a hard-driving team.
normal.cn: aggression 与 aggressor 保留了公开的敌意，而 aggressive 也可以用来称赞一支拼劲十足的团队。

normal.en: In sales talk an aggressive campaign is one that walks right up to the buyer.
normal.cn: 在销售语境里，aggressive campaign 就是一直走到买家面前的推广。

normal.en: Medicine speaks of an aggressive tumour because it advances fast, like an army.
normal.cn: 医学说 aggressive tumour，是因为它推进得快，像一支军队。

abstract.en: Picture a person leaning forward with one foot already across the line.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人身体前倾，一只脚已经越过了界线。

abstract.en: The same step can be a fist, a sales pitch or a tumour: only the target changes.
abstract.cn: 同一个迈步动作可以是拳头、推销话术或肿瘤，变的只是对象。

abstract.en: The word is a thermometer of tone: said of an enemy it is blame, said of a sales team it is praise.
abstract.cn: 这个词像一支语气温度计：用在敌人身上是责备，用在销售团队身上就是称赞。

examples.en: The dog became aggressive whenever a stranger came near the gate.
examples.cn: 只要有陌生人靠近大门，那条狗就变得凶猛。

examples.en: The startup grew through aggressive advertising rather than word of mouth.
examples.cn: 这家初创企业靠猛烈的广告投放而不是口碑成长起来。

examples.en: Doctors found an aggressive form of cancer in his left lung.
examples.cn: 医生在他的左肺发现了一种侵袭性很强的癌症。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿格瑞西夫」——阿格往前一步、顶到你面前：好斗，也指一股往前冲的狠劲。

root: 拉丁语 ad-「朝向」加 gradi「走、迈步」构成动词 aggredi「走向、扑向、攻击」，其过去分词词干 aggress- 进入英语；本义是「朝对方迈出一步」，先有「攻击的」之义，二十世纪又长出「进取、强势」的褒义。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of aggressive all keep one gesture, a step taken towards someone; only the target and the judgement change: a rival, a border, a market, a tumour, a surface, a portfolio.
sensesIntro.cn: aggressive 的七个义项都保留同一个动作，即朝某人迈出一步；变的只是对象与评价：对手、边境、市场、肿瘤、材料表面、投资组合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one foot crosses a line, the body leans forward, and the step is aimed at whoever stands ahead.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只脚越过界线，身体前倾，这一步直指站在前面的人。

branches.en: THE PERSON: the step becomes a threat, and the word means ready to fight or quarrel.
branches.cn: 人身线：迈步变成威胁，词义就是随时准备动手或争吵。

branches.en: THE ARMY: the same step is taken by a state across a border, and it is called invasion.
branches.cn: 军队线：同一个步子由国家跨过边境来走，就叫侵略。

branches.en: THE MARKET: without hostility the step is drive, and in selling it becomes a hard push.
branches.cn: 市场线：去掉敌意，这一步就是闯劲，在推销里则成了强硬的推力。

branches.en: THE BODY: a growth that advances without restraint is described with the same word.
branches.cn: 身体线：不受约束地向前推进的病变，也用同一个词来形容。

branches.en: MATERIALS AND MONEY: the same force is measured as damage to a surface or as risk in a portfolio.
branches.cn: 材料与金钱线：同一股力量又被换算成对表面的损伤，或投资组合里的风险。

intro.en: Aggressive is a Latin prefix plus a Latin stepping root, with ordinary English endings added to build the family.
intro.cn: aggressive 由拉丁语前缀加一个表示「迈步」的拉丁词根构成，英语再添普通词尾扩展出这一词族。

latinIntro.en: Gradi, gradus, aggredi, aggressus and aggressio are all recorded in Latin, so only the deeper Indo-European root would be reconstructed, and it is not needed here.
latinIntro.cn: gradi、gradus、aggredi、aggressus 与 aggressio 在拉丁语中均有记录，因此这里不需要动用重构形式。

items.example: It gives the word a sense of direction.
items.exampleCN: 它给这个词带上方向感。

items.example: Gradi is the stepping root behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: gradi 是整个词族背后那个「迈步」的词根。

items.example: It supplies the idea of a measured step.
items.exampleCN: 它提供了「一步的距离」这一概念。

items.example: The verb already meant both approach and attack.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词当时已兼有「接近」与「攻击」两义。

items.example: English builds its adjectives on this stem.
items.exampleCN: 英语的形容词就建在这个词干上。

items.example: It forms aggressive.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 aggressive。

items.example: It forms aggressively.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 aggressively。

items.example: It forms aggressiveness.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 aggressiveness。

items.example: It forms aggression.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 aggression。
