definition_zh: 航空器；飞机（单复数同形）
definition_en: any vehicle that is designed to travel through the air, such as an airplane, helicopter or glider
core_image: 跑道尽头抬起的机头，轮子刚离开地面的那一瞬
scene: 清晨的停机坪上，一排银灰色机身停在白线内，地勤人员绕着轮子逐一检查。The ground crew checked every aircraft before the morning departures.
sceneCN: 这里 aircraft 指「航空器」（第 1 个义项：一切能在大气中飞行的载具）；句意为地勤人员在早班起飞前检查了每一架飞机。画面里是停机坪、机身与绕机检查的地勤。

pos.zh: 名词：航空器；飞机（单复数同形）

derivatives.zh: 由 aircraft 加 man 构成，义为「空军（或海军航空）地勤士兵」，是英军的一个军衔称谓
由 aircraft 加 woman 构成，义为「女性航空地勤士兵」，与 aircraftman 相对应
aircraft 加 man 的另一种拼合形式，义为「航空地勤人员」，多见于英国海军航空兵

senses.title: Any vehicle that flies
senses.titleCN: 航空器：会飞的载具总称
senses.definition: any vehicle built to travel through the air, including airplanes, helicopters, gliders and balloons
senses.definitionCN: 任何为在空中航行而制造的载具，包括飞机、直升机、滑翔机与气球
senses.example: The museum displays aircraft from the early years of flight.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展出了飞行早期的各种航空器。
senses.why: Air marks the medium and craft supplies the old sense of a vessel, so the compound covers every kind of craft that travels in that medium.
senses.whyCN: air 标出介质，craft 在这里取「航行器」的旧义，因此这个复合词能涵盖在这一介质中航行的一切载具。

senses.title: An airplane in everyday use
senses.titleCN: 飞机：日常语境中的具体指称
senses.definition: an airplane, especially when the word is used in counting, schedules or military reports
senses.definitionCN: 飞机，尤用于计数、航班安排或军事报告等语境
senses.example: The airline ordered forty new aircraft for its long-haul routes.
senses.exampleCN: 这家航空公司为长途航线订购了四十架新飞机。
senses.why: Because the fixed-wing airplane is the flying craft people meet most often, the general word is read as 'airplane' whenever nothing else is meant.
senses.whyCN: 固定翼飞机是人们最常接触的飞行载具，所以当上下文没有指别的种类时，这个总称就被直接读作「飞机」。

intro.en: Aircraft is an English compound of two old elements: air, a Greek word that came through Latin and French, and craft, a native word for skill that shifted to mean a vessel.
intro.cn: aircraft 是由两个古老成分构成的英语复合词：air 是经拉丁语与法语传来的希腊词，craft 是本族词，原指技艺，后转指船只。

items.en: Cræft meant 'strength, power, skill, art', a native Germanic noun; the modern word still carries the idea of trained ability.
items.cn: cræft 是日耳曼语本族名词，意为「力量、气力、技艺、手艺」；现代词仍带着「受训能力」的观念。

items.en: Greek aer, the lower misty air, passed through Latin aer and Old French air into English, keeping both the gas sense and the manner sense.
items.cn: 希腊语 aer 指下层带雾的空气，经拉丁语 aer 与古法语 air 进入英语，既保留气体义，也保留神态义。

items.en: Craft acquired the sense of a small vessel in the seventeenth century; how that transfer happened is source uncertain, though it is often linked to the idea of a shaped thing that floats.
items.cn: craft 在十七世纪获得「小船」义；这一转移如何发生，来源不确定，一般认为与「成形而能浮的东西」这一观念有关。

items.en: The compound air-craft is recorded in the nineteenth century for craft that navigate the air, at first balloons and airships rather than powered planes.
items.cn: 复合形式 air-craft 在十九世纪有记录，指在空中航行的载具，最初是气球与飞艇，而不是动力飞机。

items.en: From the early twentieth century the word is applied to powered airplanes, and its plural stays aircraft, unchanged in form.
items.cn: 二十世纪初起，这个词用来指动力飞机，其复数仍是 aircraft，形式不变。

note.en: The first group is made of other compounds with the same -craft element; the second group is made of the flying machines that aircraft covers or is compared with.
note.cn: 第一组是同用 -craft 这一成分的其他复合词；第二组是 aircraft 所涵盖或常与之比较的各种飞行器。

entries.definition: A vehicle built to travel beyond the earth's atmosphere; same -craft element, different medium.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航天器」，指在地球大气层之外航行的载具；同样用 -craft 成分，只是介质不同。

entries.definition: A boat or other vessel on water, or such vessels as a class; the same craft element with water as the medium.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「水上船只」或这类船只的总称；同样以 craft 为成分，介质换成水。

entries.definition: A vehicle that rides on a cushion of air over land or water; formed with hover plus craft.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「气垫船（或气垫车）」，指靠气垫在地面或水面上行驶的载具，由 hover 加 craft 构成。

entries.definition: A junior rank in some air forces, formed by adding man to aircraft; it names a person, not a vehicle.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指某些空军中的初级军衔，由 aircraft 加 man 构成；它指人，不指载具。

entries.definition: A fixed-wing aircraft driven by engines; the American word for what British English calls an aeroplane.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，指有固定机翼、由发动机驱动的航空器；是美式说法，英式作 aeroplane。

entries.definition: The British word for a powered fixed-wing aircraft; a direct borrowing of the French form.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，英式拼写，义为「飞机」，指动力固定翼航空器，直接借自法语形式。

entries.definition: The short everyday word for an airplane; it drops the technical precision of aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「飞机」，是日常口语的简称，不如 aircraft 精确。

entries.definition: A flying machine with rotating blades that can rise straight up; an aircraft, but not a fixed-wing plane.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「直升机」，靠旋转桨叶垂直起降；属于航空器，但不是固定翼飞机。

entries.definition: An aircraft with no engine that flies on rising air; it shows how wide the class aircraft really is.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「滑翔机」，指没有发动机、靠上升气流飞行的航空器；它说明 aircraft 这个类别有多宽。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two real halves of the compound and the way English treats its plural.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用的是这个复合词真实的两半，以及英语处理它复数的方式。

normal.en: Air is the medium, craft is the vessel: put them together and you get a vessel for the air.
normal.cn: air 是介质，craft 是航行器：两者一合，就是「空中的航行器」。

normal.en: Craft already meant a boat before it meant a flying machine, which is why the same word serves ships, planes and spacecraft.
normal.cn: craft 在指飞行器之前先指船，所以同一个词既能用于船，也能用于飞机与航天器。

normal.en: Aircraft carrier is not a flying craft but a ship that carries them.
normal.cn: aircraft carrier 不是会飞的载具，而是载着它们的船。

normal.en: The plural is the same word: one aircraft, ten aircraft.
normal.cn: 复数和单数同形：一架 aircraft，十架还是 aircraft。

normal.en: Aircraftman adds a person to the machine, not another vehicle.
normal.cn: aircraftman 是在机器后面加上一个人，而不是又一种载具。

abstract.en: Picture two old words shaking hands: air, the invisible medium, and craft, the shaped hull that floats in it.
abstract.cn: 想象两个古老的词握手：一个是看不见的介质 air，一个是在其中漂浮的成形船体 craft。

abstract.en: Swap the medium and the same hull sails on water, rises into space or rides a cushion of air.
abstract.cn: 换掉介质，同一具船体就能在水上航行、升入太空，或压在气垫上滑行。

abstract.en: Aircraft keeps its shape in the plural because the class matters more than the count.
abstract.cn: aircraft 的复数不改形，因为这个类别本身比数目更重要。

examples.en: The airline has ordered twenty new aircraft.
examples.cn: 这家航空公司订购了二十架新飞机。

examples.en: Rescue aircraft circled the flooded valley for hours.
examples.cn: 救援飞机在被淹的山谷上空盘旋了数小时。

examples.en: Every aircraft in the fleet was checked before take-off.
examples.cn: 机队里的每一架飞机都在起飞前接受了检查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱尔克拉夫特」——爱尔（air）在天上，克拉夫特（craft）是船，合起来就是天上的船

root: air 来自希腊语 aer「下层空气」，经拉丁语与古法语进入英语；craft 是古英语 cræft「力量、技艺」，十七世纪起又指「小船」。两者在十九世纪合成 aircraft，指在空中航行的载具，二十世纪起多指飞机。

sensesIntro.en: The word has one core concept, a craft that travels through the air, and English uses it in two ways: as the whole class of flying vehicles, and in everyday counting and reports where it simply means airplanes.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词只有一个核心概念——在空中航行的载具；英语把它用在两个层面：一是涵盖所有飞行器的总称，二是在日常计数与报告中直接指飞机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shaped hull lifted off the runway, made for one medium only, the air.
core.cn: 核心意象：一具成形的机体离开跑道，只为一个介质而生，那就是空气。

branches.en: THE CLASS: air plus craft names every vehicle that travels in that medium, from balloon to helicopter.
branches.cn: 类别线：air 加 craft，命名一切在该介质中航行的载具，从气球到直升机。

branches.en: THE MEDIUM: swapping air for space or water produces spacecraft and watercraft from the same second element.
branches.cn: 介质线：把 air 换成 space 或 water，同一个第二成分就生出 spacecraft 与 watercraft。

branches.en: THE COUNT: the plural never changes, because the class is being named even when single machines are counted.
branches.cn: 计数线：复数从不改形，因为即便在数单架机器时，被命名的仍是这个类别。

branches.en: THE DEFAULT: in schedules and fleet reports the most common member of the class takes over the whole word.
branches.cn: 默认线：在航班表与机队报告里，这个类别中最常见的成员替代了整个词。

branches.en: THE PERSON: adding man or woman shifts the compound from the machine to the people who service it.
branches.cn: 人物线：加上 man 或 woman，复合词就从机器转指维护机器的人。

intro.en: Aircraft is a native compound, so its parts are ordinary English elements rather than Latin affixes.
intro.cn: aircraft 是英语本土复合词，它的构件是普通英语成分，而不是拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: Only the air half has a Latin record, borrowed from Greek aer; craft is Germanic and has no Latin cognate here.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 air 这一半有拉丁语记录，它是从希腊语 aer 借来的；craft 属日耳曼语，在这里没有拉丁同源词。

items.exampleCN: 它标出所指的是哪一种航行器。

items.example: The vessel sense is the one used here.
items.exampleCN: 这里用的是「船只、航行器」这一义。
